EAIW 1.0 统一子进程 JSON 推理协议 (ISOLATED SUBPROCESS PROTOCOL)

主程序通过独立虚拟环境子进程 (python3 models/worker_runner.py) 调用各时期历史模型（含 2023 ModelScope damo/text-to-video-synthesis）。当前配置对应的实时协议报文如下：

  "model_id": "patchmatch_telea_2009",

  "mask": "datasets/testing/sample_boonie_mask.png",
  "parameters": {
    "seed": 3786,
    "num_frames": 6,
    "fps": 8,
    "resolution": 256,
    "prompt": "low quality, PS1",
    "mask_accuracy": 1,

    "boundary_blending": 1,
    "resolution_quality": 1,
